TEAM BUILDING / FIELD NOTES

Build your first team

Start with a plan, connect your skills, and test one change at a time.

STELLA ATLAS EDITORIAL · 5 MIN READ · OCT 23, 2026
ON THIS PAGE01Give the team a purpose02Read the conditions, not just the numbers03Test on repeatable content04Keep alternatives for specific problems← All guides
STEP 01

Give the team a purpose

Choose the content you want to clear before choosing the characters. A team for comfortable progression may have different priorities from one designed to improve a clear time. Decide which Trekker is central to the plan, and read what their damage or utility depends on.

STEP 02

Read the conditions, not just the numbers

For each candidate teammate, look at who receives the effect, what triggers it, how long it lasts, and whether it is available when you need it. Matching elements can help you discover candidates, but shared element alone does not prove synergy. Verify interactions in the current skill text.

STEP 03

Test on repeatable content

Use the same stage or encounter for comparisons. Change one slot or one upgrade at a time, then observe both clear speed and reliability. A setup that finishes once but fails repeatedly is different from one you can use comfortably every session.

STEP 04

Keep alternatives for specific problems

When the core team works, make a short list of replacements for situations it struggles with. Avoid upgrading every alternative in advance. First confirm that the replacement solves a real problem and that the materials needed are worth the improvement.

About this guide

Original beginner-oriented advice, not a version-specific build or an official Yostar recommendation. Check exact skill text, costs, and unlock conditions in your current game client. Official game reference ↗
